headline: Regular School Committee meeting covering collective bargaining, personnel reports, and bids.
summary: The meeting covers collective bargaining, personnel reports, and bids, along with various reports from the school committee and subcommittees. Citizens' participation and late communications are also on the agenda.
location: Library, Northeast Metropolitan Regional Vocational School, 100 Hemlock Road, Wakefield, MA 01880
